question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=-2{x}_{1}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=3{x}_{1}(t)+4{x}_{2}(t)+5,\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=-\frac{3}{s+2},\,$
${X}_{2}(s)=$ {{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
First, we compute the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{-2{x}_{1}(t)\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{3{x}_{1}(t)+4{x}_{2}(t)+5\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=-2L\{{x}_{1}(t)\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=3L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+4L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}+5L\{1\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+3=-2{X}_{1}(s) \\ s{X}_{2}(s)-1=3{X}_{1}(s)+4{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{5}{s}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\},$ and we have used the fact that $L\{1\}=\frac{1}{s}.$

Now, solving the first equation for ${X}_{1}(s),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+3 & =-2{X}_{1}(s) \\ (s+2){X}_{1}(s) & =-3 \\ {X}_{1}(s) & =-\frac{3}{s+2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this in the second equation and solving for ${X}_{2}(s),$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{2}(s)-1 & =3{X}_{1}(s)+4{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{5}{s} \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =3{X}_{1}(s)+\frac{5}{s}+1 \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =3(-\frac{3}{s+2})+\frac{5+s}{s} \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =-\frac{9}{s+2}+\frac{5+s}{s} \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =-\frac{9s}{s(s+2)}+\frac{(5+s)(s+2)}{s(s+2)} \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{-9s+(5+s)(s+2)}{s(s+2)} \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{-9s+5s+{s}^{2}+10+2s}{s(s+2)} \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{{s}^{2}-2s+10}{s(s+2)(s-4)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution of the new system in terms of parameter $s$ is 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=-\frac{3}{s+2},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{{s}^{2}-2s+10}{s(s+2)(s-4)}.
$$
